sloka: यज्ञम् चकार सुमहान् असुरेन्द्रो महाबलः ।बलेः तु यजमानस्य देवाः साग्नि पुरोगमाः ।समागम्य स्वयम् चैव विष्णुम् ऊचुः इह आश्रमे ॥१-२९-६॥
transliteration: yajñam cakāra sumahān asurendro mahābalaḥ ।baleḥ tu yajamānasya devāḥ sāgni purogamāḥ ।samāgamya svayam caiva viṣṇum ūcuḥ iha āśrame ॥1-29-6॥

translations.english: "While Bali was performing the sacrifice (to confirm his position as lord of the three worlds), the devas got together with Agni in the forefront and approached Lord Visnu at this hermitage, saying:
